*   Input: A section of a ship specification (Section 1.3, Classification).
    *   Task: Extract explicit, checkable claims.
    *   Output Format: A single valid, parseable JSON array (or object containing an array as per schema).
    *   Constraints:
        *   No inference.
        *   No unit conversion.
        *   Fields: `section_id`, `subject`, `quantity`, `value`, `unit`, `quote`.
        *   `quantity`: What is measured (e.g., class, type, etc.).
        *   `quote`: Verbatim from text.
        *   Return empty list if no claims.
        *   Strict JSON format (no markdown, no extra text).

    *   Section ID: 1.3
    *   Title: Classification
    *   Text: "1.3 Classification\n\nThe ship will be built under supervision of Registro Italiano Navale (R.I.NA.) to obtain the following class: RINa C Research ship - Restricted navigation international - (Coastal area) , AUT- UMS, AUT-PORT, MANOVR"

    *   Claim 1: Supervision by Registro Italiano Navale (R.I.NA.).
        *   Subject: Supervision
        *   Quantity: Supervising body
        *   Value: "Registro Italiano Navale (R.I.NA.)"
        *   Unit: "" (or null/empty string)
        *   Quote: "The ship will be built under supervision of Registro Italiano Navale (R.I.NA.)"
    *   Claim 2: Class obtained.
        *   Subject: Class
        *   Quantity: Class type
        *   Value: "RINa C Research ship - Restricted navigation international - (Coastal area) , AUT- UMS, AUT-PORT, MANOVR"
        *   Unit: ""
        *   Quote: "to obtain the following class: RINa C Research ship - Restricted navigation international - (Coastal area) , AUT- UMS, AUT-PORT, MANOVR"

    *Refining Claims for "Checkable" status:*
    A claim is checkable if it's a specific requirement.
    1. Supervision: "The ship will be built under supervision of Registro Italiano Navale (R.I.NA.)"
    2. Class: "RINa C Research ship - Restricted navigation international - (Coastal area) , AUT- UMS, AUT-PORT, MANOVR"

    Let's look at the schema requirements: `section_id`, `subject`, `quantity`, `value`, `unit`, `quote`.

    Claim 1:
    - section_id: "1.3"
    - subject: "Supervision"
    - quantity: "Supervising organization"
    - value: "Registro Italiano Navale (R.I.NA.)"
    - unit: ""
    - quote: "The ship will be built under supervision of Registro Italiano Navale (R.I.NA.)"

    Claim 2:
    - section_id: "1.3"
    - subject: "Class"
    - quantity: "Classification"
    - value: "RINa C Research ship - Restricted navigation international - (Coastal area) , AUT- UMS, AUT-PORT, MANOVR"
    - unit: ""
    - quote: "to obtain the following class: RINa C Research ship - Restricted navigation international - (Coastal area) , AUT- UMS, AUT-PORT, MANOVR"

    *Wait, looking at the text again:*
    "The ship will be built under supervision of Registro Italiano Navale (R.I.NA.) to obtain the following class: RINa C Research ship - Restricted navigation international - (Coastal area) , AUT- UMS, AUT-PORT, MANOVR"

    Is "RINa C Research ship - Restricted navigation international - (Coastal area) , AUT- UMS, AUT-PORT, MANOVR" a single value? Yes, it's the class designation.

    Let's check if there are other claims.
    "AUT- UMS", "AUT-PORT", "MANOVR" are parts of the class.

    Let's structure the JSON.

    ```json
    {
      "claims": [
        {
          "section_id": "1.3",
          "subject": "Supervision",
          "quantity": "Supervising body",
          "value": "Registro Italiano Navale (R.I.NA.)",
          "unit": "",
          "quote": "The ship will be built under supervision of Registro Italiano Navale (R.I.NA.)"

        {
          "section_id": "1.3",

          "quantity": "Class designation",
          "value": "RINa C Research ship - Restricted navigation international - (Coastal area) , AUT- UMS, AUT-PORT, MANOVR",
          "unit": "",
          "quote": "to obtain the following class: RINa C Research ship - Restricted navigation international - (Coastal area) , AUT- UMS, AUT-PORT, MANOVR"
        }
      ]
    }
    ```

    *Self-Correction on "quantity":* The prompt says "Quantity should identify what is measured (for example width, height, frequency, voltage, count, or capacity)".
    For supervision, the "quantity" is the "supervising body".
    For class, the "quantity" is the "class".

    *Self-Correction on "value":* The value for class is the string.

    *Check for "explicit, checkable claims":*
    1. Supervision by RINA. (Checkable)
    2. Class RINa C... (Checkable)

    *Final check of the schema:*
    `section_id` (string), `subject` (string), `quantity` (string), `value` (string/int/num), `unit` (string), `quote` (string).
